soft.why: Softest dry compound: ~0.65 s faster than the medium when new; wear 0.042/lap × 2.8 s/wear ≈ 0.12 s/lap of degradation at an average track (plan target 0.08–0.15), cliff after ~17 laps. Slicks lose time quadratically with water: 30 s at a fully wet track, ~2.7 s already on a damp one.

medium.why: Reference compound: ~0.07 s/lap of degradation, cliff after ~27 laps at an average track; warms up slower than the soft.

hard.why: Durable compound: ~0.55 s slower than the medium when new, ~0.045 s/lap of degradation, cliff after ~41 laps; hardest to switch on, worst on a cold track.

inter.why: Intermediate: best between wetness 0.2 and 0.6. On a dry track it is ~4.5 s slower than slicks and overheats; with the slick curve the slick→inter crossover lands near wetness 0.18.

wet.why: Full wet: only worth it on standing water; the inter→wet crossover lands near wetness 0.72. On a drying track it loses time fast and overheats.

outOfWindowSPerDeg.why: Lap time lost per °C of track temperature outside a compound's working window: a 10 °C miss costs ~0.2 s/lap.

outOfWindowWearPerDeg.why: Extra wear per °C outside the window (as a share of normal wear): a tyre out of its window also degrades faster — graining when cold, blistering when hot.

offBandWearFactor.why: Wet-weather tyres on a track drier than their band wear up to this many times faster at bone dry: inters overheat and destroy themselves on a drying line.

carTyreManagementRef.why: Car tyre-management rating at which wear is nominal.

carWearPerPoint.why: Wear change per rating point of car tyre management: a car 10 points kinder on its tyres wears them ~8% slower.

driverTyreManagementRef.why: Driver tyre-management attribute at which wear is nominal.

driverWearPerPoint.why: Wear change per point of the driver's tyre management: a gentle driver makes a stint ~6% longer per 10 points.

fuelWearPerKg.why: Extra wear per kg of fuel on board: a full car (~100 kg) wears its tyres ~15% faster than an empty one.

puncture.why: Random punctures: roughly one car in four races per season-lap budget; twelve times likelier on a tyre past its cliff. A puncture costs ~20 s limping to the pits and ends the race one time in ten.
